nodes.norm_label: globe <-> sky transition (skyblend, groundcover, descent pitch-up)
nodes.rationale: Ground, clouds and atmosphere complete their cover at skyBlend 0.5 while the camera still looks down, so the globe rim (a second horizon) never shows.

nodes.label: Eclipse-dimmed magnitudes (Sun obscuration, lunarEclipseLight quadrature)
nodes.community_name: The astronomy behind Planet Location Marker (ASTRONOMY.md)
nodes.rationale: AE.Illumination ignores shadows, so the snapshot dims magnitudes itself; 72-point quadrature within 0.03 mag of brute force.

nodes.label: The astronomy behind Planet Location Marker (ASTRONOMY.md)
nodes.community_name: The astronomy behind Planet Location Marker (ASTRONOMY.md)
nodes.norm_label: the astronomy behind planet location marker (astronomy.md)
nodes.rationale: All astronomy code is pure (no DOM, no three.js) so it runs identically in the page, the module worker and Node tests.

nodes.label: Inline critical CSS (loader, no-webgl, is-intro body classes)
nodes.norm_label: inline critical css (loader, no-webgl, is-intro body classes)
nodes.rationale: Paints the loader and bare page before any module has loaded.

nodes.label: Inline loader screen (#loader, progress bar, rotating tips)
nodes.norm_label: inline loader screen (#loader, progress bar, rotating tips)
nodes.rationale: A failed import, syntax error or unsupported browser always ends on a readable screen, never a blank page.

nodes.label: window.__pcEnv feature detection (importmap, webgl2, renderer, maxTex)
nodes.norm_label: window.__pcenv feature detection (importmap, webgl2, renderer, maxtex)
nodes.rationale: main.js reads window.__pcEnv instead of probing WebGL a second time; the probe context is released with WEBGL_lose_context.

nodes.label: Offline-first critical path (vendored deps, no CDN)
nodes.norm_label: offline-first critical path (vendored deps, no cdn)
nodes.rationale: Nothing on the critical path needs the network; the only optional network use is online place search (open-meteo, then Photon, then Nominatim).

nodes.label: Generated-data freshness check (build-sky / build-milkyway --check)
nodes.rationale: Keeps data/sky.json and data/milkyway.png reproducible from data/raw.

nodes.label: Offline headless smoke matrix (desktop sub-path, mobile, UTC + reduced motion)
nodes.norm_label: offline headless smoke matrix (desktop sub-path, mobile, utc + reduced motion)
nodes.rationale: Every external host is unresolvable so boot must not need the network (SPEC §H); served under the Pages sub-path so any absolute URL fails in CI, not in production; the UTC time-zone run exists because v1 died on systems whose time zone is UTC.

nodes.label: Pages deploy gate (CI success on push to main, deploy the tested commit)
nodes.norm_label: pages deploy gate (ci success on push to main, deploy the tested commit)
nodes.rationale: Deploys exactly the commit CI tested (workflow_run head_sha); manual dispatch is allowed; a plain branch deploy still works because the site needs no build step and .nojekyll stops Jekyll.

nodes.label: Global error capture (error / unhandledrejection before __pcBooted)
nodes.rationale: Before main.js has started any error is fatal; afterwards main.js owns error handling (per-feature fallbacks, text mode).

nodes.label: Import map (three -> vendor/three)
nodes.rationale: Must precede any module script or modulepreload; vendored three.js resolved locally, never from a CDN.

nodes.label: Headless Chrome smoke test (all external hosts blocked)

nodes.label: Astrometric J2000 drawing vs apparent of-date tables
nodes.community_name: The astronomy behind Planet Location Marker (ASTRONOMY.md)
nodes.norm_label: astrometric j2000 drawing vs apparent of-date tables
nodes.rationale: The star catalogue is astrometric J2000, so beams drawn in that frame land on the right stars; the tables show what an observer measures. They differ by annual aberration (<=20.5") plus refraction.

nodes.label: Matrix layout gotcha (Astronomy Engine rotation transpose)
nodes.community_name: The astronomy behind Planet Location Marker (ASTRONOMY.md)
nodes.norm_label: matrix layout gotcha (astronomy engine rotation transpose)
nodes.rationale: AE RotateVector uses rot[j][i], so aeRotToM3 transposes; a test checks it against RotateVector to 1e-15.

nodes.label: Reduced accuracy badge (outside 1800–2200)
nodes.community_name: The astronomy behind Planet Location Marker (ASTRONOMY.md)
nodes.rationale: Uncertainty in ΔT dominates far from the present (about a minute near year 1000, tens of minutes toward 3000).

nodes.label: Static sky, moving Earth
nodes.community_name: The astronomy behind Planet Location Marker (ASTRONOMY.md)
nodes.rationale: Stars, constellations and the Milky Way are placed once in J2000; precession and nutation appear as the Earth's axis moving inside the fixed sky.

nodes.label: Downgrade-only quality governor
nodes.rationale: Frame-time EMA above 1.3x budget for 2 s lowers DPR by 0.25, then drops a tier, with a 5 s cooldown; never upgrades; not sampled under navigator.webdriver.

nodes.label: Geodetic observer pin on a unit sphere with ENU basis
nodes.norm_label: geodetic observer pin on a unit sphere with enu basis
nodes.rationale: The pin normal equals the WGS84 geodetic zenith, so altitudes match Astronomy Engine; the cost is at most about 21 km of position error.

nodes.rationale: A paused, idle app draws nothing; Live at 1x redraws about twice a second when the snapshot goes stale.

nodes.norm_label: rendermodule contract (object3d, apply, update, setlayers, setviewmode, setselection, setquality, dispose)
nodes.rationale: main.js adds object3d to the scene and modules never add themselves; the create() list order is the update order.

nodes.norm_label: text mode (no webgl2 / no import maps fallback)

nodes.label: Dynamic import of UI and render stack from main.js
nodes.norm_label: dynamic import of ui and render stack from main.js
nodes.rationale: A browser without import maps still gets text mode; a broken UI module leaves the globe running; a broken render module leaves the panels running.

nodes.label: Three-strikes module guard
nodes.rationale: Contains failures: a module that throws three times is hidden with one toast; a renderer that keeps throwing hands over to text mode.

nodes.label: R5: No per-frame allocation
nodes.rationale: Steady memory; the smoke test checks geometry and texture counts at 1 day/s.

nodes.label: R1: Pure modules (astro, core, geo, data)
nodes.norm_label: r1: pure modules (astro, core, geo, data)
nodes.rationale: They run unchanged in Node tests and in the module worker; import maps do not apply inside workers or Node.

nodes.label: R6: Shader fragments end with tonemapping/colorspace includes
nodes.norm_label: r6: shader fragments end with tonemapping/colorspace includes
nodes.rationale: The includes are no-ops behind the composer and tone-map on the low-tier direct path.

nodes.label: R2: Only render, camera, main.js and app import three
nodes.norm_label: r2: only render, camera, main.js and app import three
nodes.rationale: Keeps the 3D engine swappable and the rest testable.

nodes.label: R3: UI never imports three or render
nodes.norm_label: r3: ui never imports three or render
nodes.rationale: Text mode needs the UI to work without WebGL or import maps.
